Comments: Box capacitors recommended for aesthetic purposes.
These are 10 pin male headers, not female pin sockets.
All resistors ¼W, 1% metal film recommended
Recommended model: Bourns PEC12R-4225F-S0024. Many encoder models fit this footprint, but note: A lot of encoders I've used had the A and B pins reversed, and turned backwards as a result.
Recommended model: E-Switch TL1105BF250Q. These are the red ones.
Use a 128x64 SPI display, NOT an I2C. You can tell it's SPI if it has 7 pins. If it has 4 pins, it's an I2C model.
